_meta.description: Skill database from the eog.gg hub (361 skills: 192 techniques, 169 charms; 27 classes from Warrior/Mage to the tier 7 classes, plus 32 monster/companion skills), with class, type, cooldown in turns, tags, the in-game description text, keyword names, and damage % per quality. kind = skill | keyword | quality_ladder. A null cooldown on a technique means the source lists none. Starting rarity and shard costs are not in the source. Skill names match the global client for tiers 1-4 where we could compare; tier 5-7 names are unverified.

records.description: Heals all allies within 4 grids of the caster once.

records.name: Radiant Rhythm
records.description: Heals 1 ally within 4 grids of the caster once. The effect then chains to 1 random ally within 4 grids of the target, up to 5 times. Repeated healing on the same target is diminished by 35% per instance.

records.name: Radiant Sear
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Light DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

records.name: Radiant Warp
records.description: Increases the caster's DMG RES. When taking Technique DMG, there's a 50% chance to teleport to any empty grid within 4 grids of the caster. Can trigger only once per turn.

records.name: Raging Maelstrom
records.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster, with a 40% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid towards the caster.

records.name: Raging Wildfire
records.description: Has a 20% chance to inflict Burn to grids within range when casting a Fire Technique.

records.name: Rapid Cast
records.description: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. At the start of battle, reduces the CD of all Techniques by 1 turn. (Techniques already off cooldown are not affected.)

records.name: Rebound
records.description: Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF.

records.name: Reflective Armor
records.description: While shielded, the caster reflects a percentage of DMG taken back to the attacker as Light DMG once for each Technique attack received.

records.name: Rejuvenating Elixir
records.description: Carries 3 potions at the start of battle. When an allied character's HP falls below 50%, uses a potion to heal them. Produces 1 potion every 3 turns, holding up to 3 at a time.

records.name: Rejuvenating Rain
records.description: Heals 1 ally within 5 grids of the caster once. If the target's HP is below 50%, this healing effect is increased by 20%.

records.name: Relentless Frenzy
records.description: Increase the caster's SPD for each enemy unit killed. Stacks up to 4 times.

records.name: Repelling Wind
records.description: Has a 75% chance to trigger Repelling Wind when an enemy actively enters within 2 grids of the caster, dealing Wind DMG once, with a 100% base chance to knock them back 2 grids. (Triggers again if they approach repeatedly)

records.name: Restrain
records.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster and reduces the enemy's SPD by 10% for 1 turn.

records.name: Resurrection
records.description: When an allied adventurer dies, immediately revives and heals them once, granting Revitalization for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This Charm can only trigger once per battle. At the start of battle, if multiple allied adventurers are dead, reviving the one with the highest Power first.

records.name: Ricocheting Shield
records.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, then bounces to another random enemy within 3 grids up to 4 times. 30% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn when dealing damage. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

records.name: Ring of Omen
records.description: At the start of the caster's turn, reduces Effect RES of all enemies within 5 grids of the caster. This effect is unique. Also there's a 50% base chance to inflict Vulnerability for 1 turn.

records.name: Ripple Impact
records.description: When the caster's shield is fully broken, deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, with a 100% base chance to inflict 3 stacks of Cold for 2 turns.

records.name: Riptide
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Water DMG once with a 40% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn.

records.name: Rock Break
records.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster.

records.name: Rock Rex Summon
records.description: Summons 1 Rock Rex in front of the caster. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Technique can only trigger once per battle.)

records.name: Sacred Create Water
records.description: Selects a target within 4 grids of the caster. Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target.

records.name: Sacred Rhythm
records.description: From the caster's 3rd turn onward, increases DMG dealt at the start of each turn. Stacks up to 3 times.

records.name: Sacred Shine
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid.

records.name: Sanctified Soul
records.description: Enters the Sanctification state for 2 turns, reducing DMG taken by the caster and all allied characters within 4 grids of the caster. The effect is unique and cannot be dispelled. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Scarlet Zeal
records.description: Each Technique cast grants a stack of Battle Zeal and increases the caster's ATK. At 6 stacks, Battle Zeal converts to Scarlet Zeal, greatly increasing the caster's ATK for 2 turns. (Battle Zeal doesn't stack while Scarlet Zeal is active.)

records.name: Seismic Tide
records.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

records.name: Shadow End
records.description: Teleports to an empty grid adjacent to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to the target. Killing the target triggers this skill again. Can be cast up to 4 additional times per turn.

records.name: Shadow Erosion
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy, there is a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.

records.name: Shadow Impact
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of that target grid. If the enemy target carries Erosion, triggers Erosion effect twice immediately.

records.name: Shadow of Termination
records.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster. If the target carries Erosion, triggers all Erosion stacks immediately. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Shadow Vengeance
records.description: Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters Shadow Form, lasting until the end of the caster's turn (cannot be dispelled). In this form, the caster is immune to all DMG, can't be healed, won't be the primary target of attacks, deals increased DMG, and reduces Technique CD by 2 turns. (The caster dies immediately if failing to win when Shadow Form ends, ignoring any effects that would preserve HP.)

records.name: Shadowstep
records.description: Within a single turn, each time the caster loses over 10% of max HP, reduces DMG taken and increases SPD for 2 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.

records.name: Shadowy Current
records.description: Increases the caster's Dark DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target.

records.name: Sharp Feathers
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to generate a Wind Orb near the caster. At the end of the caster's turn, the caster selects a target within 4 grids. Each Wind Orb then attacks that target, dealing Wind DMG once. (Max Wind Orbs: 10)

records.name: Shattering Dance
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG 3 times, with a 60% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Riven Heart for 1 turn. Stacks up to 3 times. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Shattering Ice
records.description: When a target frozen by the caster removes the Frozen state, additionally deals Water DMG once.

records.name: Shattering Sigil
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Fire DMG once and inflicting Sigil. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Snipe
records.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

records.name: Solaris Storm
records.description: Deals Fire DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the caster, then deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 2-grid circular area around the caster. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Soul Breaker
records.description: Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost of the target. Stacks up to 5 times.

records.name: Soul Impact
records.description: When the caster's summon dies or expires, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of it.

records.name: Soul Pact Resonance
records.description: Grants an ATK boost when the caster has a summon on the battlefield.

records.name: Soul Piercer
records.description: Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 3x2 grid area in front of the caster, with a 10% Lifesteal effect.

records.name: Soul Protection
records.description: At the start of battle, converts 50% of the caster's current HP into a shield. Restores HP proportional to the remaining shield strength upon victory.

records.name: Soul Reap
records.description: Deals Dark DMG twice to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster. For every 5% HP lost by the target, this skill deals 5% more DMG, up to a max of 50% increase. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Soul Spark
records.description: Increases the ATK of the caster's summons but reduces their duration by 2 turns. (Summons last at least 1 turn; this Charm does not affect summons without a turn limit.)

records.name: Soul Splash
records.description: The caster's Single-Hit Techniques deal more DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target. The DMG dealt is 60% of the overkill DMG.

records.name: Soulbond Restoration
records.description: When the caster's summon dies or expires, heals the caster once.

records.name: Soulfire Protection
records.description: At the start of battle, consumes 50% of the caster's current HP to grant the caster a DMG Reduction effect. This effect cannot be dispelled.

records.name: Soulweave
records.description: When 3 of the caster's summons die or disappear, summons 1 Infernal Fiend in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Charm can only trigger once per battle.)

records.name: Source of Vitality
records.description: Heals the caster once at the start of the caster's turn.

records.name: Spirit Aegis
records.description: Grants Spirit Mark to the allied character with the lowest HP within 5 grids of the caster.

records.name: Spirit in Fire
records.description: Reduces DMG taken during the caster's turn.

records.name: Star Shattering Slash
records.description: Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Starlight Burst
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

records.name: Stone Skin
records.description: Reduces the caster's DMG taken for 1 turn for every 1 instance of Technique DMG the caster takes. This effect can stack up to 9 times.

records.name: Stonechief Summon
records.description: Summons a Stonechief in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats and remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Storm Rhapsody
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 3 times to all enemies within 3 grids of the target grid with a 35% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid towards the center of the battlefield.

records.name: Strength Rules
records.description: Increases the caster's Physical Mastery.

records.name: Stunning Strike
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG once, with a 40% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn.

records.name: Summoner's Frenzy
records.description: Increases the ATK of summons.

records.name: Summoning Pact
records.description: Summoning consumes 2% of the caster's max HP to increase the summon's HP. Restores all HP consumed by this Charm if the caster survives until victory.

records.name: Sunset Sword
records.description: Deals Physical DMG 5 times to all enemies in a 3x2 grid area in front of the caster.

records.name: Swirling Blade
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Water DMG once and converting 20% of the DMG dealt into a shield (up to 50% of the caster's max HP) for the caster for 2 turns.

records.name: Tactical Adaptation
records.description: When there are 3 or fewer enemies within 2 grids, increases the caster's DMG dealt. When there are more than 3 enemies within 2 grids, reduces the caster's DMG taken.

records.name: Tempest Edge
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy, causes additional Wind DMG once.

records.name: Tempest Sphere
records.description: Deals Wind DMG 5 times to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.

records.name: Thalasson Summon
records.description: Summons 1 Thalasson next to the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Technique can only trigger once per battle.)

records.name: Thunder Judgment
records.description: When an enemy within 5 grids of the caster casts a Technique, there's a 30% chance to trigger Thunder Strike, dealing Light DMG once. The chance increases to 90% if the target is inflicted with Electro or Wet.

records.name: Thunder of Judgment
records.description: Deals Light DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Thunderbolt Mark
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Light DMG to an enemy, there is a 65% base chance to inflict Electro.

records.name: Tough Soul
records.description: Increases the caster's HP.

records.name: Treantling Summon
records.description: Summons a Treantling behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, but cannot be the primary target of attacks or healing. It remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Twin Gale
records.description: Deals Wind DMG twice to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.

records.name: Unstable Aura
records.description: When the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 25% chance to trigger Aura, dealing additional Wind DMG once, with a 60% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

records.name: Valor Surge
records.description: Grants a DMG Boost to all allied characters within 5 grids of the caster for 2 turns and dispels 1 random status ailment or debuff. (Casts once before battle starts.)

records.name: Vital Rhythm
records.description: At the start of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Rhythm if the caster's HP is above 30%. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

records.name: Void Blessing
records.description: Selects a grid within 4 grids of the caster. Increases max HP of all allied characters within 2 grids of the target grid by a percentage of the caster's Max HP for 3 turns. This effect is unique. If the target's HP is below 30%, additionally performs a 5% healing. (Casts once before battle starts.)

records.name: Void Bubble
records.description: When the caster's HP drops below 50% for the first time in a battle, grants a shield to the caster based on max HP for 2 turns and Dodge for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).

records.name: Void Chant
records.description: Creates a magic rune that lasts 2 turns. When an enemy within 5 grids casts a Technique, the rune deals Dark DMG once to them. If the target carries Erosion, triggers the Erosion effect once. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Warrior's Essence
records.description: Increases the caster's ATK.

records.name: Water Assault
records.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 3x4 grid area in front of the caster. DMG decreases by 25% for each subsequent hit on the same target. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)

records.name: Water Shot
records.description: Deals Water DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.

records.name: Water to Ice
records.description: When the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to trigger Condensation, dealing additional Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

records.name: Waterling Summon
records.description: Summons a Waterling behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, but cannot be the primary target of attacks or healing. It remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Weakening Hex
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.

records.name: Whirlwind Slash
records.description: Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the caster.

records.name: Wind Blade Slash
records.description: Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1x4 grid area in front of the caster, with a 50% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.

records.name: Wind Blade Spiral
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, with a 40% base chance to inflict Laceration for 1 turn.

records.name: Wind's Delight
records.description: Selects a grid within 6 grids of the caster. Launches 7 waves of wind blades at the target grid and random enemies within 1 grid to the target grid's left and right. Each wave deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the enemy target. DMG decreases by 35% for each subsequent hit on the same target.

records.name: Wind's Shadow
records.description: Has a 30% chance to deal additional Wind DMG once and a 50% base chance to delay the target's action by 20% after dealing Wind DMG 3 times to an enemy with Techniques.

records.name: Wind's Whisper
records.description: Increases the caster's Wind DMG.

records.name: Windless Lord
records.description: Increase DMG dealt by the caster's Wind Orbs. Each time a Wind Orb is generated, there's a 70% chance to generate another, up to 4 times per turn.

records.name: Summon Shadow
records.description: Summons 1 Shadow beside the caster, which acts immediately. The summon inherits a portion of the caster's stats. (Can only be cast once per battle)

records.name: Summon Flame Dragon
records.description: Summons 1 Flame Dragon in front of the caster, which acts immediately. The summon inherits a portion of the caster's stats, enters Stealth, and can exist on the battlefield for up to 3 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Healing Radiance
records.description: Heals all allies within 4 grids of the caster once, and randomly disperses 1 Ailment or Debuff from each.

records.name: Nightrite Sigil
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG twice to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Erosion. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Void Incursion
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG twice, with a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.

records.name: Word of Judgment
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within a 2-grid cross area of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.

records.name: Summoner's Whisper
records.description: Increases the ATK of the caster's summons. At the start of the caster's turn, advances the action of 1 random summon of the caster's within 5 grids by 30%.

records.name: Spirit Pact Incantation
records.description: When the caster's summon ends its turn, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of it.

records.name: Sage's Blessing
records.description: Each time the caster heals an ally with a Technique, has a 50% chance to grant them DMG taken reduction for 1 turn. This effect is unique.

records.name: Curse Shadow Decree
records.description: Each time the caster successfully inflicts a Debuff on an enemy with a Technique, has a 50% base chance to additionally inflict 1 Erosion.

records.name: Umbral Soul Armor
records.description: Reduces DMG taken by the caster. At the end of the caster's turn, immediately triggers 1 instance of the caster's own Erosion effect within 5 grids of the caster.

records.name: Truth Communion
records.description: Every 8 Dark Techniques cast, the caster enters Communion for 2 turns, which cannot be dispersed. During Communion, the caster's DMG dealt is increased, and DMG dealt by Techniques gains a 10% Lifesteal effect. (Techniques cast during Communion do not count toward the tally)

records.name: Blade Rain Frenzy
records.description: Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 3x2 grid area in front of the caster. For every 5% the caster's SPD exceeds the target's, this skill's DMG to that target increases by 5%, up to a maximum of 50%.

records.name: Phantom Blade Dance
records.description: Performs 6 attacks. With each attack, teleports to an empty grid beside a random enemy within 3 grids of the caster and deals Physical DMG once to it. If the same target is hit repeatedly, the DMG dealt decays by 50% successively.

records.name: Shadow Prison Bind
records.description: Leaps to any empty grid within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns, and pulls them to the caster's surroundings.

records.name: Searing Flame Slash
records.description: Deals Fire Doom DMG once to all enemies within a 3x1 grid area in front of the caster.

records.name: Hellfire Fist
records.description: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 1x3 grid area in front of the caster, with a 40% base chance to knock them back 1 grid. If the same target is hit repeatedly, the DMG dealt decays by 40% successively. (Can hit large targets multiple times)

records.name: Condemnation Sigil
records.description: Inflicts a Sigil on 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster for 1 turn, which cannot be dispelled. During this time, the caster's DMG to that target is increased. When the Sigil disappears, the target additionally takes Physical True DMG once, equal to 30% of the DMG dealt to its HP during this time (excluding True DMG). (Prioritizes large targets; a target can only be inflicted with 1 Sigil at a time)

records.name: Bloodfire Frenzy
records.description: Before battle begins, the caster enters an Excited state for 3 turns, which cannot be dispelled. During this time, the caster's DMG dealt is increased. When the Excited state ends, the caster enters an Exhausted state for 3 turns, which cannot be dispelled, during which the caster's DMG taken is increased by 100%.

records.name: Pursuing Blade
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, has a 40% chance to deal Physical DMG once more to it. For every 5% the target's HP is reduced, this skill's DMG to that target increases by 5%, up to a maximum of 50%.

records.name: Cursed Armor
records.description: For each Ailment or Debuff the caster has, the caster's DMG taken is reduced, stacking up to 5 times. This cannot be dispelled.

records.name: Eroding Force
records.description: Increases the DMG dealt by the caster's single-hit Techniques. For each Ailment or Debuff the target has, the effect increases by 10%, stacking up to 5 times.

records.name: Gathering Wind Spirit
records.description: For each Wind Orb the caster has, the caster's Technique DMG dealt is increased, stacking up to 10 times. This cannot be dispelled.

records.name: Honed Edge
records.description: Increases the caster's Physical Mastery. Each time the caster's Technique deals Physical DMG to an enemy, has an 80% chance to apply 1 stack of Honed Edge to the caster, lasting until the end of the caster's turn, stacking up to 20 times.

records.name: Surging Burst
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 40% base chance to inflict Wet for 2 turns.

records.name: Glacial Spike
records.description: Selects a grid within 4 grids of the caster. Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn. (Zero initial CD)

records.name: Heaven's Wrath
records.description: Deals Light DMG 9 times in total to random enemies within 5 grids of the caster. If the same target is hit repeatedly, the DMG dealt is reduced by 30% successively.

records.name: Rending Cyclone
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 4 times to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid and knocks them Airborne.

records.name: Pyre Detonation
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Absorbs all Burn applied by allies within 3 grids of it, and deals Fire Doom DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the grid. For each Burn absorbed, the DMG dealt by this skill increases by 10%, up to a maximum of 100%. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Smoldering Dark Flame
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, and inflicts Burn on the grid. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Surging Tide
records.description: Increases the caster's Elemental RES. Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, has a chance to trigger Surging Tide, advancing the caster's action by 20%, up to 2 times per turn. The trigger chance starts at 0% and increases by 5% for each equipped Technique that deals Water DMG.

records.name: Torrential Momentum
records.description: Each time the caster casts 5 Water Techniques, the caster enters the Torrent state for 2 turns, which cannot be dispelled. During this state, the caster's DMG dealt is increased, and after each Technique cast, has a 30% chance to reset its cooldown and cast it again, up to 2 times per turn. (Techniques cast during the Torrent state do not count toward the tally)

records.name: Spirit Flame Detonation
records.description: Every 3 turns, increases the DMG dealt by the caster's Blast Spirit once, up to 2 times, which cannot be dispelled. The caster's Blast Spirit gains an effect upgrade.

records.name: Myriad Runes
records.description: Each time the caster casts a Technique with a damage effect, condenses 1 rune of the corresponding element beside the caster, increasing the caster's corresponding attribute, which cannot be dispelled.

records.name: Raging Gale
records.description: Increases the DMG dealt by the caster's Laceration. When a Technique strikes an enemy target from a normal state into Airborne, triggers Laceration once.

records.name: Radiant Fusion
records.description: Increases the caster's Light DMG. Each time the caster casts a Light Technique, the caster randomly gains 1~3 stacks of Charge. Every 4th Light Technique cast consumes all Charge, with each stack increasing the DMG dealt by that Technique by 8%. (The 4th Light Technique cast does not accumulate Charge)

records.name: Skyvault Shield Charge
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical Doom DMG once, with a 150% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn. (Prioritizes large targets)

records.name: Sacred Prism Armor
records.description: Activates Prism Armor for 2 turns, which cannot be dispersed. While active, each time the caster takes Technique DMG, counters by dealing Light DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. (Zero Initial CD)

records.name: Radiant Spirit Blade
records.description: Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, then bounces to a random enemy within 3 grids of that target, bouncing up to 5 times. When the caster has 5 or more stacks of Charge, consumes 5 stacks of Charge to increase this Technique's DMG by 50%. If the same target is hit again, the DMG dealt is reduced by 40% successively. (Can hit large targets multiple times)

records.name: Phantom Tide Pull
records.description: Deals Water DMG twice to all enemies within 4 grids of the caster, with a 50% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold for 2 turns, and pulls them to around the caster.

records.name: Surging Vortex Dance
records.description: Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster.

records.name: Twin Radiance Aegis
records.description: Applies a Shield based on the caster's DEF to the caster and to the lowest-HP ally within 5 grids of the caster for 2 turns each.

records.name: Punishing Force
records.description: Increases the caster's Physical Mastery. Each time the caster's Technique deals Physical DMG to an enemy, has a 70% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Crippled for 2 turns, stacking up to 3 times.

records.name: Skyvault Radiance
records.description: Increases the caster's Light affinity. At the end of the caster's turn, gains 2 stacks of Charge, stacking up to 20 stacks, which cannot be dispersed.

records.name: Holy Light Blessing
records.description: For each equipped Technique that deals Light DMG, reduces the DMG the caster takes, stacking up to 3 times, which cannot be dispersed.

records.name: Frostbind Breath
records.description: Awakens the caster's ability before battle begins. Reduces the DMG taken by the caster and all allied characters within 5 grids of the caster from enemies inflicted with Cold, and each stack of Cold on the target increases this DMG reduction by 20%. This effect is unique and cannot be dispersed.

records.name: Tidal Sigil
records.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, gains 1 stack of Tidal Sigil. When it stacks to 15, counters by dealing Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster based on the caster's DEF.

records.name: Ironguard Body
records.description: Each time the caster's HP drops by 10%, increases the caster's DEF, stacking up to 5 times, which cannot be dispersed.

records.name: Freeze Burst
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, dealing Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

records.name: Scorched Earth
records.description: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 3-grid circular range of the caster, with a 40% chance to inflict Burn on the terrain.

records.name: Gale Feather
records.description: Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 6 times to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid, with an 80% base chance to inflict Laceration for 1 turn.

records.name: Headwind Strike
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster, dealing Wind DMG 3 times. If the target is within 3 grids of the caster, the caster retreats 1 grid.

records.name: Voidlight Abyss
records.description: Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1x7 grid range in front of the caster. When hitting the same target repeatedly, DMG dealt is reduced by 40% from the 3rd hit onward. (Can hit large targets multiple times)

records.name: Thunderstorm Net
records.description: Randomly releases 8 ball lightnings within a 3x5 grid range in front of the caster, each dealing Light DMG once and conducting to a random enemy within 2 grids. (The skill prioritizes including large targets within its range)

records.name: Frostbound Undercurrent
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, has a 50% chance to deal Water DMG once more, with a 30% base chance to inflict Immobilize for 1 turn.

records.name: Risen from Flame
records.description: The first time the caster takes lethal DMG, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters the Risen from Flame state. Absorbs all Burn inflicted by allies within 3 grids of the caster, granting the caster 1 Shield based on the caster's max HP per Burn absorbed, lasting until the Risen from Flame state ends.

records.name: Blazing Resonance
records.description: Per Burn inflicted by allies within 4 grids of the caster, increases the caster's Fire affinity. Stacks up to 10 times.

records.name: Void Wind
records.description: Increases the caster's Wind affinity. Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, has a 10% base chance to Knockback 1 grid.

records.name: Gale Scar
records.description: Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, has a 50% chance to deal Wind DMG once more, with a 5% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Riven Heart for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.

records.name: Sigil Integration
records.description: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Up to 2 Magic Sigils per element, with a maximum of 5 existing at once.

records.name: Summon: Flower Spirit
records.description: Summons 1 Flower Spirit behind the caster and makes it act immediately. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. It is in Stealth and remains on the field for up to 3 turns. (Standby)

records.name: Summon: Spirit Armor
records.description: Summons 1 Spirit Armor near an enemy within 4 grids of the caster and makes it act immediately. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (This Technique activates only once per battle)

records.name: Dark Erosion Blast
records.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster, with a 50% base chance to inflict Slow 1 for 2 turns. If the target is afflicted with Erosion, the Erosion effect immediately triggers 12 times.

records.name: Eroding Hex
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Punishment Sigil for 2 turns.

records.name: Night Shade Wandering Spirit
records.description: Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster and all enemies within a 1-grid square area of that enemy, then bounces to a random single enemy within 3 grids of that enemy (up to 2 times). (Can hit large targets multiple times)

records.name: Benevolent Wish
records.description: Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Grants a DMG reduction effect to all allied characters within 3 grids of the target grid for 2 turns. Only the strongest such effect takes effect, and additionally removes 1 random Ailment or Debuff. (This skill can be cast even while Taunted or Frenzied)

records.name: Spirit Caller's Whisper
records.description: When a summon with a turn-limited duration dies or disappears, grants 1 Shield based on the caster's max HP to 1 summon with an unlimited duration for 2 turns. (This Charm only affects the caster's own summons)

records.name: Spirit Caller's Focus
records.description: During battle, the first summon with an unlimited duration that the caster summons takes reduced DMG and deals increased DMG.

records.name: Spirit Caller's Erosion
records.description: Increases the caster's Erosion DMG. Each time the caster casts a Technique and deals Dark DMG to an enemy, if the target is afflicted with Erosion, the Erosion effect immediately triggers 1 time with a 100% chance.

records.name: Cursed Shadow Link
records.description: When the caster inflicts a Debuff on an enemy with a Technique, has a 50% chance to deal Dark DMG once.

records.name: Spirit Elixir Specialization
records.description: For each Potion the caster holds, increases the healing the caster provides. Potion creation speed rises by 1 every 2 turns, and increases the healing from the caster's Potions by 50%.

records.name: Guardian Totem
records.description: At the start of the caster's 3rd turn, summons 1 Guardian Totem in front of the caster and makes it act immediately. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. The Guardian Totem takes no DMG from enemies but also cannot be healed.

records.name: Wind Gather
records.description: Creates 4 Wind Orbs around the caster.

records.name: Spin Edge
records.description: Selects a grid within 2 grids of the caster. Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid.

records.name: Sky Render
records.description: Deals Physical DMG 6 times to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

records.name: Dark Soul Devour
records.description: Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the caster, with a 20% Lifesteal effect.

records.name: Scorch Strike
records.description: Teleports to an empty grid adjacent to the lowest-HP enemy within 5 grids of the caster, then deals Fire DMG once to that target.

records.name: Stellar Annihilation
records.description: Deals Fire DMG to the lowest-HP enemy within 1 grid of the caster. For every 10% of HP the target has lost, this skill's DMG increases by 20%, up to a maximum of 200%.

records.name: Swift Power
records.description: Increases the caster's SPD. At the end of the caster's turn, has a 40% chance to reduce the cooldown of 1 random Technique on cooldown by 1 turn.

records.name: Starfire Edge Will
records.description: At the start of the caster's turn, the caster gains 2 stacks of Edge Will. Stacks up to 4 times and cannot be removed.

records.name: Tenacious Body
records.description: Before battle begins, the caster's ability awakens, reducing the DMG the caster takes. Additionally, until the end of the caster's 2nd turn, this effect is increased by 200%.

records.name: Shadow Dive
records.description: At the end of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Shadow. At 2 stacks, the effect triggers, healing the caster once and granting Stealth. Lasts 1 turn and cannot be removed. (Shadow stacks do not increase while Stealth is active.)

records.name: Swift Shadow Laceration
records.description: When the caster moves of their own accord, inflicts 1 stack of Laceration for 1 turn on all enemies within 1 grid of the caster. Stacks up to 3 times.

records.name: Frenzied Blood Resolve
records.description: At the start of the caster's turn, inflicts a Resolve Mark on the enemy that dealt the most DMG to the caster on the previous turn, lasting until the end of the caster's turn.

records.name: Counter Stance
records.description: Enters a Counter state. This state lasts for 2 turns and cannot be removed. While active, each time the caster takes Technique DMG, there is a 30% chance to trigger a counterattack, dealing Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF, with a 40% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn. (The state is removed after the counterattack triggers)

records.name: Hundred Battle Blade
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG once. During battle, each time this skill is cast, the DMG dealt by this skill increases by 10%, up to 100%.

records.name: Wild Dance Strike
records.description: Deals Physical DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 3x1 grid area in front of the caster, with the final hit having a 50% base chance to knock them back 1 grid. For every 5% the caster's DEF exceeds the target's, the DMG dealt by this skill increases by 5%, up to 50%.

records.name: Charge Cry
records.description: Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1x4 grid area in front of the caster. If the caster has 10 or more stacks of Charge, consumes 10 stacks of Charge to cast this skill again. Can be re-cast at most once per turn.

records.name: Charge Slash
records.description: Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, and grants the caster 2 stacks of Charge.

records.name: Frostward Guard
records.description: Grants the caster a Shield based on the caster's DEF, lasting for 2 turns. While the Shield is active, each time the caster takes Technique DMG, there is a 50% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Cold on the attacker for 2 turns.

records.name: United Bulwark
records.description: At the start of battle, grants Unity to all allied characters within a 3-grid square area of the caster, including the caster. Only the highest-value instance of the same effect is active, and it cannot be removed.

records.name: Immovable Body
records.description: Increases the caster's Effect RES. When knocked back or pulled, there is a 50% chance to trigger Immovable, nullifying the movement.

records.name: Defensive Posture
records.description: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, increases the caster's DEF for 1 turn. Stacks up to 10 times. Additionally, has a 20% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 on the attacker for 2 turns.

records.name: Covenant Guard
records.description: At the start of battle, forms an unremovable Covenant with all allied adventurers within 5 grids of the caster. Triggers the first time an allied adventurer's HP drops to 40% or below, lasting for 1 turn. During this time, the caster takes the enemy Technique DMG in their place, and reduces the DMG the caster takes when hit.

records.name: Energy Flow
records.description: At the start of battle, the caster gains 14 stacks of Charge. Each time 2 stacks of Charge are consumed, increases the caster's ATK for 2 turns. Stacks up to 7 times.

records.name: Frost Domain
records.description: Increases the caster's Water affinity. When an enemy within 2 grids of the caster ends their turn, has a 100% base chance to inflict 1 to 3 random stacks of Cold for 2 turns.

records.name: Skylight Phantom Blade
records.description: Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Light DMG once, then bounces to a random enemy within 3 grids of it, up to 5 bounces. When the caster has 5 or more stacks of Charge, consumes 5 stacks of Charge to increase this Technique's DMG by 50%. If it hits the same target repeatedly, the DMG dealt is reduced by 40% successively. (Can hit large targets multiple times)

records.name: Action Advance
records.description: Advances the bearer's action bar, accelerating their turn.

records.name: Action Delay
records.description: Delays the target's action. A target can be delayed by up to 80% per turn.

records.name: Adventurer
records.description: Main character only. Companions, summons, and materialized Fantomons are not included.

records.name: Affinity
records.description: Increases the caster's DMG dealt with the corresponding element.

records.name: Ailment
records.description: Severe status effects include: Frozen, Stun, Immobilize, Frenzy, and Action Delay. After a target is inflicted with an Ailment, the chance of ailment infliction next turn is halved and keeps dropping with each consecutive infliction.

records.name: Airborne
records.description: Targets in the airborne cannot counterattack. Blocking removes the airborne state. Large targets cannot be knocked airborne. Airborne is a brief state. If left unharmed, the airborne target will soon fall and return to normal.

records.name: Approach
records.description: After being knocked back, if Movement is above 0, approaches the target to unleash a Technique. Before the caster's turn ends, if a Technique is ready but out of range, spends remaining Movement to approach the nearest target.

records.name: Armor Break 2
records.description: Reduces DEF by 30%. When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.

records.name: At the Start of Battle
records.description: When a character has multiple pre-battle skills to cast, they are activated in order: Charms before Techniques, from top to bottom based on their slot order. If multiple units have pre-battle skills, they act in order of highest to lowest SPD at the start of the pre-battle phase. The formal battle turn begins after all units from both sides have cast these skills.

records.name: Base Chance
records.description: Represents the base chance of inflicting ailments on the target. The final chance is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit and the target's Effect RES.

records.name: Blast Spirit
records.description: Activates the Blast Spirit at the end of the caster's turn. If an enemy is within 2 grids of the caster, it explodes to deal Fire DMG once to all enemies within range. Explosion DMG counts as Technique DMG.

records.name: Blessing
records.description: A character can only receive one Blessing at a time.

records.name: Blind
records.description: Grants a 50% chance to miss the target when using the next damaging Technique.

records.name: Blood Source
records.description: When a target with Blood Source takes Technique DMG, 3% of the DMG dealt is converted to the attacker's HP (up to 50% of max HP). DMG taken by shields does not trigger this effect.

records.name: Burn
records.description: Inflicts Burn for 3 turns, dealing Fire DMG once to enemies with it. DMG Triggers: 1. When the grids is newly inflicted with Burn; 2. When an enemy moves to the Burned grids (doesn't apply to traversal); 3. At the start of a turn for an enemy standing on the Burned grids. Multiple instances of Burn DMG from the same skill by the same caster in one turn are reduced by 35% successively, up to 3 times. Notes: 1. On the same grid, the newly inflicted Burn will replace the old one. 2. Burn cannot be inflicted on water surfaces.

records.name: Character
records.description: Main character and companions only. Summons and materialized Fantomons are not included.

records.name: Charge
records.description: A stacking resource accumulated by the caster. Certain Techniques consume stacks of Charge to gain bonus effects.

records.name: Clone
records.description: The clone's type (Character, Summon, Monster, Fantomon, etc.) matches the connected target. When the clone takes lethal DMG, that DMG (including any overflow) chains to the connected target. When the clone disappears, any debuffs on it chain to the connected target.

records.name: Cold
records.description: Increases Water DMG taken by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

records.name: Connection
records.description: Prioritizes connecting to large-sized targets. Each target can only be connected to one clone.

records.name: Consumption
records.description: Consumes the character's HP to a minimum of 1. Charms still activates even if less or no HP is deducted.

records.name: Debuff
records.description: Negative effects include: stat reduction (e.g., ATK Reduction), DMG over time (e.g., Erosion), increased DMG taken (e.g., Shattering Sigil), Blind, Taunt, etc.

records.name: Dodge
records.description: When attacked, the bearer has a 50% chance to be immune to the incoming DMG.

records.name: Doom DMG
records.description: Shield Break: Deals +100% DMG to the enemy target's shields. Deals +100% DMG to enemy summons.

records.name: Electro
records.description: When the target with Electro takes Light DMG from a Technique, removes the Electro to deal additional Light DMG once and chain it to 1 random enemy within 2 grids of the target.

records.name: Elemental Mastery
records.description: Increases the caster's DMG dealt and effectiveness with elemental skills.

records.name: Erosion
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Erosion (Cursed Armor)
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Erosion (Dark Bullet)
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Erosion (Linked Misfortune)
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Erosion (Mana Blast)
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Erosion (Shadow Erosion)
records.description: At the start of each turn, triggers Erosion once, dealing Dark DMG once. Erosion lasts for 3 turns. If the same character inflicts Erosion again with the same skill, the duration stacks.

records.name: Fear
records.description: Will not prioritize the inflictor of this status as an attack target.

records.name: Flame
records.description: Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square area of the bearer. Triggers: when the status is gained, at the start of the bearer's turn, after the bearer moves, and when enemy targets enter the range. DMG is attributed to the caster. This effect does not stack.

records.name: Frenzy [Ailment]
records.description: Frenzied enemies treat all targets except themselves as enemies. When using Techniques, they randomly target enemies within their attack range. Summoning Techniques remain available, but self-targeting Techniques (grant buffs, healing, shields, etc.) are disabled while frenzied.. Base Resilience Break: 60

records.name: Frozen [Ailment]
records.description: Prevents movement and skill use, and disables activation of Charms or status effects that require casting. Cannot be frozen again while frozen. Base Resilience Break: 50

records.name: Heal
records.description: When casting healing Techniques, only heals targets with less than 100% HP. Healing power is based on the caster's max HP.

records.name: Immobilize [Ailment]
records.description: Cannot move. Base Resilience Break: 30

records.name: Indomitable
records.description: Reduces DMG taken by 90%.

records.name: Knockback
records.description: Knocks back the enemy target a certain distance. If collision occurs with other units or obstacles, the colliding enemy target take Physical DMG once equal to 10% of their max HP, at a max of 60% of the caster's ATK.

records.name: Laceration (Cyclone Lament)
records.description: Takes Wind DMG once when moving (including skill movement, knockback, or pull effects). Laceration status lasts 1 turn and can stack.

records.name: Laceration (Wind Blade Spiral)
records.description: Takes Wind DMG once when moving (including skill movement, knockback, or pull effects). Laceration status lasts 1 turn and can stack.

records.name: Lifesteal
records.description: Heals the caster for a percentage of DMG dealt to the target. DMG to shields does not trigger this effect.

records.name: Magic Sigil
records.description: A sigil generated per element by the Charm - Sigil Integration, boosting the caster's Elemental Mastery while active.

records.name: Max HP Boost
records.description: The bearer maintains the current HP percentage when effects that boost max HP are applied or removed.

records.name: Movement
records.description: Usually, characters can move up to 4 grids per turn. Movement from skills is separate and does not count towards this limit.

records.name: Non-Character Units
records.description: Non-character units include Monsters, Summons, and materialized Fantomons.

records.name: Note
records.description: The DMG is fixed and unaffected by Effects or Affinities. In PvP battles, overkill DMG from defeating Summons and Fantomons drops to 20% and 33%, respectively.

records.name: Prioritized as Attack Target
records.description: Techniques prioritizing large targets will also attack clones first, except for Divine Wrath.

records.name: Punishment Sigil
records.description: Increases DMG taken for the next Technique hit. Prioritizes the inflicted target for enemy attacks.

records.name: Revitalization
records.description: Reduces DMG taken by 90%.

records.name: Rhythm
records.description: Upon taking lethal DMG, the caster survives with 1 HP, consumes 1 stack of Rhythm, and heals the caster once.

records.name: Riven Heart
records.description: Reduces Block Rate by 10%. Stacks up to 3 times.

records.name: Shattering Sigil
records.description: Increases DMG taken by 60% for the next Technique hit. Prioritizes the inflicted target for enemy attacks.

records.name: Shield
records.description: Absorbs DMG, depleted before HP when taking DMG. When multiple shields are present: 1. Shields with a turn limit are depleted first, followed by shields without a turn limit; 2. Shields of the same type are depleted in order they applied.

records.name: Single-Hit Technique
records.description: A Technique that deals a single instance of damage, such as Edge Strike or Fire Slash.

records.name: Slow 1
records.description: Reduces SPD by 15%. When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.

records.name: Slow 2
records.description: Reduces SPD by 30%. When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.

records.name: Spirit Mark
records.description: When the bearer takes single DMG exceeding 4% of max HP, consumes the Marks to reduce DMG taken.

records.name: Stun [Ailment]
records.description: Prevents skill CD reduction, movement, and skill use during the affected unit's turn. Also blocks activation of Charms or statuses that require casting. Base Resilience Break: 50

records.name: Summon
records.description: Summon's level equals the skill level. Summons cannot receive any stat boosts.

records.name: Taunt
records.description: Taunted enemies target the caster only, and approach the caster when using damaging Techniques. Summoning Techniques remain available, but ally-targeting Techniques (grant buffs, healing, shields, etc.) are disabled while taunted.

records.name: Unique Stack
records.description: When a target is affected by this effect multiple times, only the best effect is retained.

records.name: Vigil
records.description: A character can only receive Vigil once at a time, and Vigil cannot protect the caster themselves.

records.name: Vulnerability
records.description: Increases DMG taken by 25%.

records.name: Weakened 1
records.description: Reduces ATK by 15%. When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.

records.name: Weakened 2
records.description: Reduces ATK by 30%. When multiple levels of the same status exist, only the highest level takes effect.

records.name: Wet
records.description: Increases the chance of being Frozen by 30%.

records.name: Wind Orb
records.description: A wind orb generated by the Charm - Sharp Feathers.

records.name: Zero Initial CD
records.description: This skill can be cast on the caster's first turn and enters cooldown after casting.

records.notes: The damage % is constant inside a quality; the flat damage part rises at every step. A skill's starting quality is not in the source.
